input: Research electric bike models within my commuting budget

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The actual budget ceiling determines which tier of e-bikes to consider — entry-level, mid-range, or premium — and completely shapes the shortlist.
Commuting needs vary widely: distance per day determines required battery range, which filters out many models.
The terrain and infrastructure (hilly vs. flat, bike lanes vs. roads, urban vs. suburban) affects motor power and frame type requirements.
Rider physical attributes (height, weight) affect which frame sizes and motor ratings are appropriate, narrowing the viable model list.
Where the bike will be stored and charged (apartment, garage, office) affects whether a removable battery or folding design is necessary.
Style priorities — such as throttle vs. pedal-assist, cargo capacity, or brand reputation — determine which features to weight in the comparison.
Knowing what a good outcome looks like (a ranked shortlist, a single recommendation, a side-by-side spec table) defines how deep and what format the research should take.

gold.taskTitle: Research electric bike models within commuting budget
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate electric bike models that fit the user's budget and are suited for their commuting needs.

questions.title: What is your exact maximum budget for the bike?
questions.description: Establish the hard spending ceiling in dollar terms to scope the entire model search.

questions.title: How many miles is your typical daily commute?
questions.description: Determine required battery range per charge, which filters out models that cannot cover the round trip.

questions.title: Is your commute route hilly, flat, or mixed terrain?
questions.description: Identify the motor power and torque requirements based on the elevation profile of the route.

questions.title: What is your height and approximate weight?
questions.description: Ensure recommended models have suitable frame sizes and motor ratings for the rider's physical profile.

questions.title: Where will you store and charge the bike daily?
questions.description: Determine whether a removable battery, compact frame, or folding design is necessary based on storage constraints.

questions.title: Do you prefer pedal-assist, full throttle, or either?
questions.description: Identify the preferred riding mode and any other feature priorities such as cargo capacity, integrated lights, or brand.

questions.title: What should the final research output look like?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a ranked shortlist, a single top pick, a side-by-side spec comparison, or links to purchase.
